value.summary: Management demonstrates strong execution in scaling new verticals like IT hardware and telecom, though they frequently face delays in commissioning large-scale facilities. Their credibility is supported by maintaining market share in a declining mobile market and successfully navigating complex component price cycles.

promises.quote: Our expansion into new category of semi-automatic washing machines in 16 kg and 18 kg capacity is completed and mass production to start in March '26
promises.promised: Mass production of 16kg and 18kg semi-automatic washing machines to start in March 2026.
promises.actual_delivered: Management confirmed in May 2026 (page 6) that they have started manufacturing semi-auto washing machines in 16 and 18 kg capacity.
promises.reasoning: The launch was promised for March 2026 and confirmed as active in the May 2026 transcript.

promises.quote: scale up our capacity by operationalizing a new upcoming Chennai facility by end of Q4 of the current fiscal.
promises.promised: Operationalize a new Chennai facility for AC PCBs by the end of Q4 FY26 (March 2026).
promises.actual_delivered: In May 2026 (page 7), management reported they added a new facility in Chennai strategically located closer to their anchor customer.
promises.reasoning: The facility was promised for the end of the fiscal year and reported as added in the subsequent earnings call.

promises.quote: Construction of a 1 million square feet facility in Noida with higher capacities for our anchor customers is expected to be completed by Q1 of financial year '26-'27
promises.promised: Complete construction of the 1 million sq ft Noida facility by Q1 FY27 with mass production starting in Q2 FY27.
promises.actual_delivered: By August 2026 (page 4), management stated the facility was almost completed and operations were now expected to commence from Q3 FY27.
promises.reasoning: The commencement of operations was pushed from Q2 to Q3 FY27.

promises.quote: Our new Tirupati facility for front-loading washing machine is ready and mass production to start by Q2 financial year '26-'27 with annual capacity of 300,000 units.
promises.promised: Start mass production of front-loading washing machines at the Tirupati facility by Q2 FY27.
promises.actual_delivered: In November 2026 (page 7), management noted they were still progressing towards the launch of these machines in Q3 of the current fiscal.
promises.reasoning: The launch was delayed from the original Q2 FY27 target to Q3 FY27.

promises.quote: mass production of SSD and memory modules is planned to begin in Q2 of '26-'27, which will deepen the level of manufacturing
promises.promised: Begin mass production of SSD and memory modules in Q2 FY27.
promises.actual_delivered: In November 2026 (page 11), management reported that lines for SSD had been set up and trials were operationalized, implying a Q3 start for production.
promises.reasoning: The transition from planning to operational trials occurred in Q3, missing the Q2 mass production target.

promises.quote: Our new 4,000 square feet facility for 74:26 launch at JV for manufacturing of smartphones and other electronic devices is expected to start operations by Q2 of '26-'27.
promises.promised: Start operations at the new Longcheer JV facility by Q2 FY27.
promises.actual_delivered: In November 2026 (page 5), management stated the Longcheer JV is expected to commence operation within Q3 of the current financial year.
promises.reasoning: The operational start date was moved from Q2 to Q3 FY27.

bull.point: The IT Hardware segment is experiencing rapid growth and transitioning to higher incentive categories.
bull.quote: IT hardware vertical is witnessing a very significant growth driven by increasing volumes, deepening customer engagement, leading to a strong order pipeline

bull.point: Strategic backward integration into components like displays and camera modules is expected to expand margins.
bull.quote: foray into display modules, camera modules, mechanicals, and other critical components represent a significant step in Dixon's evolution

bull.point: Dixon is maintaining stable mobile volumes despite a significant double-digit decline in the broader Indian smartphone market.
bull.quote: Dixon has demonstrated resilience by sustaining its smartphone manufacturing volume at broadly stable year-on-year levels.

bear.point: Margins are under pressure due to the expiration of PLI incentives and high global component costs.
bear.quote: Margins during the quarter were impacted on expiration of mobile PLI 1 scheme along with elevated global memory prices

bear.point: Strategic inventory building for memory chips has led to a significant working capital burn.
bear.quote: in H1, we have seen a cash burn of INR 280 crores. I think it is primarily because of memory

bear.point: The Home Appliances segment is facing temporary profitability hits from volatile raw material and freight costs.
bear.quote: Profitability in washing machine and refrigerator was temporarily affected by fluctuations in polymer prices, rising freight costs and transit time
